sources.text: the ledger report is useless to me in the morning. its a wall of numbers and i dont know what to do with it. i want to open tinkery and in like 5 seconds know if yesterday went well or not. maybe one number? useful changes per hour is the one that matters. cost too maybe. i dont want a dashboard. also the 6am job sometimes fails silently and i only find out days later
a failed job should override everything. cost only matters if its way off

framings.text: Know within about five seconds each morning whether yesterday went well, primarily through useful changes per hour, while making job failures visible before they go unnoticed.

supports.quote: i want to open tinkery and in like 5 seconds know if yesterday went well or not.
useful changes per hour is the one that matters.
the 6am job sometimes fails silently and i only find out days later

previous.outcome: A minimal morning view that gives a clear yesterday assessment, with useful changes per hour as the main signal, cost as possible context, and an explicit indication when the 6am job failed.

questions.text: What specifically should make yesterday count as having gone well: a target or threshold for useful changes per hour, a comparison with another day, or something else?

alternatives.label: One-number summary
alternatives.cost: May hide cost, failure state, or why the result changed.

alternatives.label: One-number summary plus cost and job status
alternatives.benefit: Preserves speed while exposing the two stated concerns.
alternatives.cost: Could begin to feel like a dashboard.
